title: FilmBox
summary: Film camera for Cardputer Zero: 18 film looks, 8MP, zoom and QR Wi-Fi export
description: FilmBox turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket film camera. 8 MP photos on the full IMX219 sensor, 18 switchable film looks (Provia, Velvia, Classic Chrome, ACROS, Portra, Ektar, Ektachrome, HP5 and more), 1x/1.5x/2x/3x zoom, GIF, silent 720p video, timelapse and stop-motion. A full-bleed viewfinder with a see-through side panel, or a slim pure-framing mode. Press W to start a token-protected Wi-Fi gallery and scan the QR code: photos open in any phone browser. Photos are saved with the film look baked in, plus halation and grain. Film copies render on the GPU (EGL/GLES2) in about 1.6 s for a full 8 MP frame. Screenshots are rendered from the app's own drawing code; no photograph is bundled.
